sections.h2: What Good UI/UX Actually Means for Your Product

paragraphs.text: UI (user interface) is how a product looks — layout, color, typography, buttons. UX (user experience) is how it feels to use — how easily someone finds what they need and completes a task. A UI/UX design company in Kochi has to get both right, because a beautiful screen that confuses users fails just as often as a functional screen that looks outdated. That balance is the standard every project at Teknoppy is measured against.

sections.h2: How We Work — Our Design Process

items.text: We study your business, your users, and your competitors before any screen is designed.
